methodology_note: Study units derived from Toronto Notes SOURCE STRUCTURE (toc_inventory.json / derived/scope_packets/H.json). Chapter H has 92 source nodes, 0 unresolved_headings per the deterministic packet, but a distinct structural defect was found and independently resolved during this pass, more severe than any single-page two-column merge documented in prior chapters (G.S05, GS.S12, D): nodes H.S22 and H.S23 carry titles/T-children naming real clinical content (Sickle Cell Disease, Autoimmune Hemolytic Anemia, Microangiopathic Hemolytic Anemia/TMA, Hereditary Spherocytosis, Hereditary Elliptocytosis, Glucose-6-Phosphate Dehydrogenase Deficiency) whose true body content, confirmed via raw OCR (derived/toronto-notes-2025/clean-ocr/0675.txt-0678.txt), is physically located ~40 pages earlier, within H.S07's own declared page range (H18-H24, pdf 672-678) - immediately following H.S07's Thalassemia T-children. The page ranges recorded on H.S22/H.S23 in toc_inventory.json (H61-H64, pdf 715-718) instead point to two genuine bibliographic sections - 'Landmark Hematology Trials' (confirmed via clean-ocr/0715.txt-0716.txt) and 'References' (confirmed via clean-ocr/0717.txt-0718.txt) - that have no other node bearing their title anywhere in the chapter's 92 nodes. This is resolved as follows, per the rule against inventing headings and the instruction to resolve ambiguity via canonical TOC -> raw/normalized OCR -> body-heading confirmation: (1) H.S22's concatenated title 'Sickle Cell Disease Landmark Hematology Trials' is treated as two real headings sharing one node (the same class of same-node title-concatenation already seen in GY.S12's 'SexualAbuse'/'Sexuality and Sexual Dysfunction' split), each represented as its own study unit citing H.S22 with the page range corrected to match its confirmed body content (SU-H-18 Sickle Cell Disease at pdf 675-677/H21-H23; SU-H-50 Landmark Hematology Trials at pdf 715-716/H61-H62). (2) H.S22.T01 'Autoimmune Hemolytic Anemia' keeps its own correctly-worded title but its page range is corrected to pdf 677/H23 (SU-H-19). (3) H.S23 'Microangiopathic Hemolytic Anemia' and its T01 'Microangiopathy (TMA)' (a redundant duplicate of H.S23 itself and of H.S10.T02's already-covered TMA content) are consolidated into one unit (SU-H-20) with page range corrected to pdf 677/H23. (4) H.S23.T02/T03 (Hereditary Spherocytosis, Hereditary Elliptocytosis) are consolidated as one unit (SU-H-21, pdf 678/H24, both membrane-defect hemolytic anemias presented together in the source) and H.S23.T04 (G6PD Deficiency) is its own unit (SU-H-22, pdf 678/H24). (5) The genuine 'References' bibliography confirmed at pdf 717-718/H63-H64 has no toc_inventory.json node bearing that title anywhere in this chapter (unlike every other completed chapter's terminal References section) - it is represented with a synthetic id, UNCATALOGUED:H.REFERENCES, per the project's established convention for confirmed-real-but-uncatalogued content (see chapter A's 'Monitoring', chapter D's dropped headings, chapter FM's Acronyms/Antimicrobial-Reference precedents), as SU-H-51. No fabricated headings were introduced; every unit above is grounded in confirmed body text, not model memory. Aside from this one defect (fully resolved), chapter H's remaining 21 sections and their T-children map cleanly to their stated titles and page ranges.

study_units.title: Sickle Cell Disease
study_units.structural_rationale: toc_inventory.json node H.S22 carries the concatenated printed title 'Sickle Cell Disease Landmark Hematology Trials' with a recorded page range of H61-H62 (pdf 715-716). Raw OCR confirmation (clean-ocr/0675.txt-0677.txt) shows Sickle Cell Disease is a genuine, extensive major topic (definition, pathophysiology, HbSS/HbSC/HbAS clinical features, vaso-occlusive/aplastic/sequestration crisis management, hydroxyurea therapy, screening) immediately following H.S07.T05 (a-Thalassemia) within H.S07's own declared page range (H18-H24); clean-ocr/0715.txt-0716.txt instead confirms pdf 715-716 is genuinely 'Landmark Hematology Trials' (see SU-H-50). This unit is therefore cited against H.S22 (the node bearing this title) but with the page range corrected to its confirmed body location, per the same-node title-concatenation precedent set by GY.S12 and documented fully in this file's methodology_note.

study_units.title: Autoimmune Hemolytic Anemia
study_units.structural_rationale: toc_inventory.json node H.S22.T01 ('Autoimmune Hemolytic Anemia', LOW confidence, TOC_OCR_UNANCHORED) carries a correct title but a recorded page range of H61-H62 inherited from its mis-scoped parent H.S22. Raw OCR (clean-ocr/0677.txt, Table 14 'Classification of AIHA') confirms the genuine content (warm vs. cold AIHA, Coombs testing, management) sits within H.S07's page range immediately after Sickle Cell Disease. study_units.title: Microangiopathic Hemolytic Anemia / Thrombotic Microangiopathy (Definition and Etiology)
study_units.structural_rationale: toc_inventory.json node H.S23 ('Microangiopathic Hemolytic Anemia', HIGH confidence, TOC_OCR) carries a correct title but a recorded page range of H63-H64 (pdf 717-718); its T01 'Microangiopathy (TMA)' is a redundant duplicate of the same content and of H.S10.T02 ('Thrombotic Microangiopathies (TMAs)', already covered by SU-H-26). Raw OCR (clean-ocr/0677.txt) confirms the genuine MAHA/TMA definition-and-etiology content (vasculitis, eclampsia/HELLP, malignant hypertension, drug- and infection-induced causes, cross-referencing TTP/HUS/DIC by page number) sits within H.S07's page range, immediately after AIHA. Consolidated into one unit citing both H.S23 and H.S23.T01 with the corrected page range; genuine TTP/HUS/DIC clinical management remain covered independently at SU-H-26 and SU-H-30. See methodology_note for the full page-range defect.
